skill_name: Compare and contrast two different types of database management systems.
workflow: Relational database management systems (RDBMS) are effective options when it comes to structured data and involve the use of tables, relations, and normalization. Non-relational database management systems (NoSQL) do not require a fixed structure, so it can store and process unstructured data more quickly or in greater quantities.
